blocks.text: In 2003, Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

In the action and adventure category, Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
